scenes.tts: A floor plate and a piece of dorsal spinal cord sit apart in a gel. How could one steer the other?
scenes.visual: Title card: Something Crosses the Gel. Two tissue pieces in a clear gel with a gap between them. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: A floor plate and a piece of dorsal spinal cord sit apart in a gel. How could one steer the other?

scenes.tts: Start on the map: commissural axons grow from the dorsal cord toward the floor plate.
scenes.visual: The transverse spinal cord map: dorsal commissural neurons at top, floor plate at the ventral midline, ventricular zone around the central canal, pial surface at the outer edge, commissural path drawn from dorsal cord down near the pia, then in across the floor plate. The dorsal cord and the floor plate are highlighted; the commissural path pulses.
scenes.narration: Start on the map: commissural axons grow from the dorsal cord toward the floor plate.

scenes.tts: In nineteen eighty-eight, in Thomas Jessell's laboratory, Marc Tessier-Lavigne and colleagues tested this in a dish.
scenes.caption: In 1988, in Thomas Jessell's laboratory, Marc Tessier-Lavigne and colleagues tested this in a dish.
scenes.visual: Label: 1988, Jessell laboratory. The dorsal piece and the floor plate are cut out of the map and lifted into a dish.
scenes.narration: In 1988, in Thomas Jessell's laboratory, Marc Tessier-Lavigne and colleagues tested this in a dish.

scenes.tts: They cut pieces of embryonic rat spinal cord. Each piece was an explant, living tissue cultured outside the embryo.
scenes.visual: Small tissue blocks drop into a dish. Label: explant, living tissue cultured outside the embryo.
scenes.narration: They cut pieces of embryonic rat spinal cord. Each piece was an explant, living tissue cultured outside the embryo.

scenes.tts: They set the explants in a collagen gel. Some held dorsal spinal cord, others floor plate.
scenes.visual: A block of collagen gel; a dorsal explant and a floor plate explant suspended inside it, apart.
scenes.narration: They set the explants in a collagen gel. Some held dorsal spinal cord, others floor plate.

scenes.tts: First, the control. A dorsal explant sits in the gel on its own. What should it do?
scenes.visual: A dish with only the dorsal explant. Question on screen: alone, what does it do?
scenes.narration: First, the control. A dorsal explant sits in the gel on its own. What should it do?

scenes.tts: On its own, it sent out few or no axons.
scenes.visual: The lone dorsal explant with few or no axons leaving it. Label: control, few or no axons.
scenes.narration: On its own, it sent out few or no axons.

scenes.tts: Now place a floor plate explant nearby. Bundles of commissural axons grew out of the dorsal explant, toward the floor plate.
scenes.visual: The second dish: a floor plate explant near the dorsal explant. Bundles of axons curve out of the dorsal explant toward it.
scenes.narration: Now place a floor plate explant nearby. Bundles of commissural axons grew out of the dorsal explant, toward the floor plate.

scenes.tts: The explants never touched. So the effect had to cross the gel.
scenes.visual: A bracket marks the gap between the explants. Label: no contact, something crosses.
scenes.narration: The explants never touched. So the effect had to cross the gel.

scenes.tts: A cue that draws axons from a distance is a chemoattractant. Steering by a diffusing cue is chemotropism.
scenes.visual: Faint dots spread from the floor plate into the gel; the axon tips turn toward the denser side. Labels: chemoattractant, chemotropism.
scenes.narration: A cue that draws axons from a distance is a chemoattractant. Steering by a diffusing cue is chemotropism.

scenes.tts: Picture smelling bread from down the street. You know which way the bakery is, but not the recipe.
scenes.visual: A street with a bakery at one end; scent lines drift toward a walker who turns toward it. The recipe card is blank.
scenes.narration: Picture smelling bread from down the street. You know which way the bakery is, but not the recipe.

scenes.tts: Unlike bread, whether netrin draws you in depends on who is smelling it.
scenes.visual: Two walkers smell the same scent: one walks toward the bakery, one walks away.
scenes.narration: Unlike bread, whether netrin draws you in depends on who is smelling it.

scenes.tts: To name the molecule, you must purify it. Floor plates are far too small.
scenes.visual: A floor plate explant beside a scale bar; it looks minute. Label: too little tissue to purify from.
scenes.narration: To name the molecule, you must purify it. Floor plates are far too small.

scenes.tts: So in nineteen ninety-four, the laboratory kept rat explants as the detector and searched embryonic chick brain.
scenes.caption: So in 1994, the laboratory kept rat explants as the detector and searched embryonic chick brain.
scenes.visual: Label: 1994. Rat explants in a row marked detector; beside them, embryonic chick brains marked source.
scenes.narration: So in 1994, the laboratory kept rat explants as the detector and searched embryonic chick brain.

scenes.tts: Thousands of brains went into the work. The extract was separated over several chromatography columns.
scenes.visual: Brain membranes become an extract poured through a series of chromatography columns, fractions dripping into tubes.
scenes.narration: Thousands of brains went into the work. The extract was separated over several chromatography columns.

scenes.tts: After each step, every fraction went back onto rat spinal cord explants. The axons reported which fractions to keep.
scenes.caption: After each step, every fraction went back onto rat spinal-cord explants. The axons reported which fractions to keep.
scenes.visual: Each tube is tested on an explant; explants with outgrowth get a tick and their tubes move on to the next column.
scenes.narration: After each step, every fraction went back onto rat spinal-cord explants. The axons reported which fractions to keep.

scenes.tts: Two proteins came through. Their sequences were related to laminin, a matrix protein, and to a worm protein, U N C six.
scenes.caption: Two proteins came through. Their sequences were related to laminin, a matrix protein, and to a worm protein, UNC-6.
scenes.visual: Two protein bands emerge. Sequence bars align with laminin and with worm UNC-6.
scenes.narration: Two proteins came through. Their sequences were related to laminin, a matrix protein, and to a worm protein, UNC-6.

scenes.tts: The authors named them netrin one and netrin two. Each promoted commissural outgrowth.
scenes.caption: The authors named them netrin-1 and netrin-2. Each promoted commissural outgrowth.
scenes.visual: Labels: netrin-1, netrin-2. Each, added to an explant, brings out bundles of axons.
scenes.narration: The authors named them netrin-1 and netrin-2. Each promoted commissural outgrowth.

scenes.tts: Does promoting outgrowth prove that netrin steers axons? Think about what the assay scored.
scenes.visual: An explant with axons growing out in all directions. Question on screen: growth, or steering?
scenes.narration: Does promoting outgrowth prove that netrin steers axons? Think about what the assay scored.

scenes.tts: No. The assay scored whether axons grew out, not which way they pointed. Outgrowth is not direction.
scenes.visual: The axons grow out but point every way. Label: outgrowth is not direction.
scenes.narration: No. The assay scored whether axons grew out, not which way they pointed. Outgrowth is not direction.

scenes.tts: A companion paper supplied direction. Floor plate cells make netrin one R N A.
scenes.caption: A companion paper supplied direction. Floor plate cells make netrin-1 RNA.
scenes.visual: The floor plate on the map lights; a label shows netrin-1 RNA in its cells.
scenes.narration: A companion paper supplied direction. Floor plate cells make netrin-1 RNA.

scenes.tts: And cells engineered to secrete netrin attracted commissural axons at a distance in the gel.
scenes.visual: A cluster of secreting cells in the gel, apart from a dorsal explant; axons turn toward the cluster.
scenes.narration: And cells engineered to secrete netrin attracted commissural axons at a distance in the gel.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: netrin is what crosses the gel, and it can attract at a distance.
scenes.visual: The transverse spinal cord map: dorsal commissural neurons at top, floor plate at the ventral midline, ventricular zone around the central canal, pial surface at the outer edge, commissural path drawn from dorsal cord down near the pia, then in across the floor plate. Box 1 fills with: netrin. Takeaway on screen: netrin crosses the gel and can attract at a distance.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: netrin is what crosses the gel, and it can attract at a distance.
